title: Strictification of a scalar Roos map
statement:
theorem scalarModelRoosZeroLift_strictify
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory)
    (D : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E X) ℤ)
    (f : (completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X).obj P.obj ⟶ integralOperationsRoos
      (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor) :
    ∃ f₀ : (completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E L ι X).obj P.obj ⟶ integralOperationsRoos
        (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor,
      (∀ i : ℤ, f₀.f i ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd (scalarRoosBoundary
          (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)).v
          i (i - 1) (by omega) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ),
        (f₀.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (scalarRoosBoundary
          (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)).f i ≫
          (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦
            (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor.obj
              (op m)) n).f i).val.app U =
        (f.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst (scalarRoosBoundary
          (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor)).f i ≫
          (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦
            (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D).asFunctor.obj
              (op m)) n).f i).val.app U)

proof.text: Transpose the compatible unshifted quotient family through the constant-tower/limit adjunction. The transpose has zero shifted coordinate, and the mapping-cocone universal property gives a strict chain map whose unshifted projections agree with those of f.

proof_origin.place: Strictification substep of the normalized scalar Roos construction
